- Added support for `dlazy login` device-code authentication (no manual API key copy/paste required).

- Clarified manual API key setup as an alternative.

Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Minor text update in agent instructions about API key saving (clarified wording in SKILL.md).
- No changes to functionality or option flags. 
- Documentation in SKILL-en.md and SKILL-cn.md also updated accordingly.

- Added a dedicated "Authentication" section with step-by-step instructions for acquiring and configuring your dLazy API key.
- Updated CLI installation to use @dlazy/cli@1.0.6 (was 1.0.5).
- Minor documentation improvements for clarity and usability across all language files.

- Initial release of dlazy-seedance-2.0 for ByteDance's latest video generation model.
- Supports multi-modal inputs: images, video, audio, and prompt for advanced video generation.
- Offers generation modes for both components and frames (including first/last frame and text-to-video).
- Includes flexible options for resolution, aspect ratio, duration, and optional audio generation.
- Provides detailed error codes and guidance for handling authorization, parameter, and balance issues.
